original_prompt: Create a brand NEW photorealistic full-length studio photograph of the adult man in the attached PORTRAIT, using it only to preserve facial identity, hair and upper clothing. Reconstruct a balanced complete body from scratch. Swept textured brown hair, gray-green eyes, strong brows and defined clean-shaven jaw; dark charcoal three-piece suit, white shirt, dark navy textured tie. Lower clothing: matching charcoal tailored trousers, polished black Oxford shoes. Well-proportioned tall adult male with approximately 7.5-7.8 heads anatomical height (skull crown to chin), elegant but believable. Moderately long legs, balanced thighs and shins, compact ribcage and abdomen, normal pelvis and neck. Crotch-to-floor about 49-50% of full standing height. Avoid both short stocky legs and excessively stretched runway legs. His previous attempt looked short-legged with an oversized torso: make the legs visibly about 8% longer relative to that attempt and the torso modestly more compact, while keeping natural anatomy and arms. Do not make a huge head or long neck. Normal sized hands and feet. Suit waist and jacket hem must visually flatter this balanced leg length; no overly long jacket. Front-facing neutral relaxed standing pose, arms naturally down, fingertips about mid-thigh. Preserve distinctive face and clothing, accurate seams, sleeves, accessories. Usual garment lengths, straight trouser legs with modest realistic drape. White seamless background with delicate floor contact shadows. Camera level at mid-body, 85mm equivalent from sufficient distance, vertical lines parallel, no low-angle perspective. Sharp natural pores, individual hair and fabric texture, premium real photography, not CGI. Full hair to soles visible with comfortable small margins. Portrait 2:3. No text, no watermark, no measurement guides. Goal is a believable handsome real man with harmonious head/torso/leg balance, not exaggerated runway proportions.
